_comment: Rhythm analysis thresholds and messages. Loaded by src/engines/rhythmEngine.js.

messages.tooFewSentences: Too few sentences to evaluate rhythm. Write at least 3.
messages.goodVariation: Good variation — rhythm supports the physical momentum.
messages.tooManyLong: Too many long sentences. Break them into shorter physical beats. Long sentences carry explanation.
messages.lowVariation: Low variation — sentences feel the same length. Mix short impact with longer movement.
messages.highAverage: Average sentence is long. Compression is likely. Break into beats.
